coverage: Locations used by the representative timeline anchors; not an exhaustive world atlas.

locations.name: East Blue
locations.summary: Eastern Blue Sea region and the starting waters for many novice pirates.

locations.name: Cocoyasi Village
locations.summary: A village in the Conomi Islands whose history is tied to Arlong's occupation.

locations.name: Alabasta Kingdom
locations.summary: A desert kingdom whose internal conflict becomes the centre of the Alabasta story.

locations.name: Skypiea / Upper Yard
locations.summary: A sky island and its upper region, where the history of Shandora and its inhabitants is central.

locations.name: Long Ring Long Land
locations.summary: An unusual island chain associated with the Davy Back Fight.

locations.name: Water Seven
locations.summary: A shipbuilding city known for its shipwrights, docks, and canals.

locations.name: Enies Lobby
locations.summary: A judicial stronghold of the World Government.

locations.name: Thriller Bark
locations.summary: A massive ship-like island operating in the Florian Triangle.

locations.name: Sabaody Archipelago
locations.summary: A mangrove archipelago and major passage point for ships heading to the New World.

locations.name: Amazon Lily
locations.summary: An isolated island inhabited and governed by the Kuja.

locations.name: Impel Down
locations.summary: A high-security underwater prison of the World Government.

locations.name: Marineford
locations.summary: The Marine headquarters location associated with the Summit War.

locations.name: Fish-Man Island
locations.summary: An underwater island beneath the Red Line and an important crossroads between seas.

locations.name: Punk Hazard
locations.summary: A hazardous island altered by a major battle and used for secret experiments.

locations.name: Dressrosa
locations.summary: A kingdom whose public image conceals the effects of its ruling family's actions.

locations.name: Zou
locations.summary: A mobile island carried on the back of the giant elephant Zunesha.

locations.name: Totto Land
locations.summary: A territory made up of many islands under Big Mom's rule.

locations.name: Mary Geoise
locations.summary: The Holy Land and seat of the World Government's highest political institutions.

locations.name: Wano Country / Onigashima
locations.summary: A closed country whose liberation and political future are central to the Wano story.

locations.name: Egghead
locations.summary: A futuristic island associated with Dr. Vegapunk's scientific work.

locations.name: Elbaph
locations.summary: The land of giants; the manga storyline remains ongoing.
